verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for a GPU cloud, which could ship an assistant or an official MCP server, so the story applies. Lambda's documented interfaces are the console, a REST API, SSH, JupyterLab and Slurm/Kubernetes tooling, none of which is natural-language. The only natural-language route is an unofficial third-party CLI and MCP server built by an outside developer, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
